data.name: Sayad
data.gender_notes: Sayad is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sayad is a name of reverence and respect, derived from the Sanskrit word 'sayas' meaning 'lord' or 'master'. It is a name often used to address a wise and powerful leader, or a revered deity. The name Sayad carries the meaning “Lord, Master” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sayad usually hope their child will grow to embody lord, master and live with faith, good character and purpose.
